tools.name: start_routine
tools.title: Start a routine
tools.description: Start (or continue) one of the person's routines, e.g. "start my morning". Returns the first step at the support level the person has earned. If a run is already in progress it is resumed instead of restarted.

routine.description: Routine name as spoken, e.g. "morning". Omit for the default routine.

device.description: Device/room the person is using, e.g. "kitchen"

speech.description: Say this to the user exactly as written, word for word. Learners rely on hearing identical wording every time; do not paraphrase, shorten or add to it.

step_id.description: Stable id of the current step; pass it to step_done / need_help

base_level.description: Support level the person has earned for this step

prompt.description: Verbatim prompt for this level; empty when the person does the step on their own

step.description: Current step, or null when the routine is finished

duplicate.description: True when this exact request was already applied (safe retry)

level_changes.description: Support-level changes caused by this call

skipped.description: Titles of steps skipped by this call

tools.name: step_done
tools.title: Mark the current step done
tools.description: The person finished the current step ("done", "next", "finished"). Pass the step_id from the previous result: completing an already-completed step is a harmless no-op, so retries never skip a step. Use all_remaining=true for "all done" (only steps the person already does on their own are completed in bulk).

tools.name: review_suggestions
tools.title: Hear the coach's suggested changes
tools.description: List routine changes the coach has suggested that are waiting for the person's decision. The person owns their routines: nothing a coach suggests takes effect until the person approves it.

speech.description: Say this to the user exactly as written, word for word. Learners rely on hearing identical wording every time; do not paraphrase, shorten or add to it.

tools.name: decide_suggestion
tools.title: Approve or decline a suggestion
tools.description: Record the person's decision on a coach suggestion ("yes" -> approved, "not now" -> declined). Approving publishes the new routine version. Only call this after the person clearly says yes or no.
